bugs_found: loan_payment returns a string with hard-coded EUR when monthly_rate is zero instead of returning Decimal consistently
compound_interest silently truncates fractional years and compounds_per_year via int(), changing caller input without validation
transfer does not coerce or validate amount as Decimal; float/string/NaN-like inputs can raise mid-operation or behave inconsistently
apply_fee can return a negative net amount when fee_min exceeds amount
fx_convert accepts zero or negative exchange rates except missing-rate None check, enabling zero/negative converted amounts
no functions validate finite Decimal values, so Infinity/NaN inputs can leak through or trigger inconsistent runtime exceptions
money results are not quantized to currency scale, allowing fractional-cent balances/payments to propagate
